warnings.name: crossing vs active landing
warnings.explain: Runway 36 has a recorded landing authorization for SIM212 (t=0) and a crossing authorization for RESCUE7 at K (t=28). Both need the 18-36 protected area.
warnings.what_would_clear_it: RESCUE7 reports clear of runway, or SIM212 go-around / landing complete
warnings.claim_limit: Two recorded authorizations / an open obligation at time t. Not a collision prediction.

warnings.explain: Stop/cancel issued to RESCUE7 at t=38; no acknowledgement heard in 10 s. The reservation is kept: the engine does not assume the stop took effect.
warnings.what_would_clear_it: RESCUE7 acknowledges, or an observed/reported stop
warnings.claim_limit: Two recorded authorizations / an open obligation at time t. Not a collision prediction.
